 Earnings To Watch: Astral Ltd (NSE:ASTRAL) Q2 2027 -- GF Value Sees 63% Upside
 GuruFocus News Wed, November 4, 2026 at 6:21 AM CST 2 min read ASTRAL.NS -11.49% 
 ASTRAL.BO -10.00% 
 This article first appeared on GuruFocus . 
 Astral Ltd ( NSE:ASTRAL ) is set to release its Q2 2027 earnings on Nov 5, 2026. The consensus estimate for Q2 2027 revenue is 19.23 billion, and the earnings are expected to come in at 6.45 per share. The full year 2027's revenue is expected to be $77.70 billion and the earnings are expected to be $26.67 per share. More detailed estimate data can be found on the Forecast page . 
 Astral Ltd ( NSE:ASTRAL ) Estimates Trends 
 Warning! GuruFocus has detected 3 Warning Signs with NSE:ASTRAL. 
 Is NSE:ASTRAL fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator. 
 Over the past 90 days, revenue estimates for Astral Ltd ( NSE:ASTRAL ) have increased from $77.05 billion to $77.70 billion for the full year 2027 and from $88.73 billion to $89.21 billion for 2028. Earnings estimates have declined from $26.71 per share to $26.67 per share for the full year 2027, while they have increased from $33.32 per share to $33.58 per share for 2028. 
 Astral Ltd (NSE:ASTRAL`)` Reported History 
 In the previous quarter of 2026-06-30, Astral Ltd's ( NSE:ASTRAL ) actual revenue was $15.78 billion, which missed analysts' revenue expectations of $16.06 billion by -1.72%. Astral Ltd's ( NSE:ASTRAL ) actual earnings were $4.47 per share, which missed analysts' earnings expectations of $4.70 per share by -4.89%. After releasing the results, Astral Ltd ( NSE:ASTRAL ) was up by 2.74% in one day. 
 Astral Ltd ( NSE:ASTRAL ) 12 Month Price Targets 
 Based on the one-year price targets offered by 27 analysts, the average target price for Astral Ltd ( NSE:ASTRAL ) is $1730.89 with a high estimate of $1965.00 and a low estimate of $1450.00. The average target implies an upside of 24.69% from the current price of $1388.20. 
 Based on GuruFocus estimates, the estimated GF Value for Astral Ltd ( NSE:ASTRAL ) in one year is $2267.57, suggesting an upside of 63.35% from the current price of $1388.20. 
 Based on the consensus recommendation from 30 brokerage firms, Astral Ltd's ( NSE:ASTRAL ) average brokerage recommendation is currently 1.80, indicating an "Outperform" status. The rating scale ranges from 1 to 5, where 1 signifies Strong Buy, and 5 denotes Sell.
